categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/addrman.cpp and carries the P2P area label, directly modifying address management and peer selection logic.
categories.rationale: Fixes a severe sampling bias in sparse addrman buckets where entries preceded by empty slots received an overwhelming selection probability (up to 95.3% vs 4.7%). While long-standing rather than an acute emergency, correcting this skew significantly improves address selection uniformity and network eclipse resistance.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: The modifications to addrman_tests.cpp and the fuzz target test p2p address manager behavior rather than test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: Does not alter test harness infrastructure or testing tools.
